documentation: Line-coverage floor enforced by .github/scripts/validate_coverage.py in build.yml. Coverage may rise freely; it may fall only within tolerancePercentagePoints. Raise a value when coverage has genuinely improved: run the suite with --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage" (or npm run test:coverage for the frontend), then `python3 .github/scripts/validate_coverage.py --format <cobertura|lcov> --report <glob> --baseline tests/coverage-baseline.json --baseline-key <project> --update-baseline` and commit the change with the work that earned it. Lowering a value needs a reason in the commit message.
toleranceRationale: The recorded values were measured on Windows while the gate runs on Linux, and platform-specific branches move the number by a point or two. Tighten this once a few Linux runs have shown the real spread.
